items.mainDefect: The blacklist check compares guest emails that are not lowercased against a lowercased blacklist, so a different casing gets past the blocklist.

secondary.defect: The existing-attendee check (guest === attendee.email) is case-sensitive, so duplicate attendees that differ only by case can be created.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist comparison is case-sensitive because only the blacklist entries are lowercased, so case variations get past it.

secondary.defect: Input guests are not deduplicated within the request (case-insensitively), so the same email can be inserted more than once.
The existing-attendee check (guest === attendee.email) is case-sensitive.

items.mainDefect: sendAddGuestsEmails is called with the raw guests array instead of the filtered uniqueGuests, so existing or blacklisted attendees are treated as new.

secondary.defect: The server schema does not enforce unique emails, so duplicate emails in a request reach createMany.

items.mainDefect: The client-side uniqueness check in AddGuestsDialog is case-sensitive, so emails that differ only by case pass validation.

secondary.defect: The server-side ZAddGuestsInputSchema does not apply the same uniqueness check, so it only runs on the client.

items.mainDefect: Guest emails are not lowercased before being compared with existing attendees and the blacklist.

secondary.defect: Guests are not deduplicated within a single request, so duplicate attendees can be created.
The attendee check reads and then writes with no isolation or DB unique constraint, so concurrent requests can insert duplicate attendees.
